asr_text: On the train, I open the For You page and see my followed topics. I have only the ride to catch up, so I do not want to sort through unrelated stories. Google News uses topics and sources I follow. It can also use my past activity on Google services and YouTube. I can follow or unfollow topics, ask for more or less, and hide a source. These controls make the feed feel partly mine. I still worry an important story could be left out, but this quick start protects my morning time.
